issue_request: FHIR-15590 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-I and asked to add a dateRecorded-style element to the Event pattern so events could capture when they were recorded.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-15590/GF#15590 commit was found. Grouped workflow-pattern commit 14b69a1c6dd33918b20d53ffd6cfbab523f840ba added Event.recorded to source/event/event-spreadsheet.xml as 0..1 dateTime with W5 mapping when.recorded and text explaining delayed recording.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists event as an active logical pattern. Later FHIR-39485 clarified Event.recorded comments and is already audited on the combined branch. FHIR-46490 updated the external Extension Pack event-recorded extension wording, which is outside this core checkout. Community searches found only the original Zulip tracker bot announcement and no conflicting Confluence evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because current build-scope Event pattern source already satisfies the requested recorded-date support.
